title: Expose calculate_drift and calculate_mood interfaces in evolution.py
description:
Update chatbot/soul/evolution.py to expose public interfaces for identity drift and mood calculations.

Before editing, inspect:
- current evolution.py implementation
- IdentityStateModel and MoodState class signatures
- Input/output conventions for pure functions
acceptance_criteria: chatbot/soul/evolution.py defines calculate_drift(identity: IdentityStateModel, conversation: list[Message]) -> IdentityStateModel
chatbot/soul/evolution.py defines calculate_mood(identity: IdentityStateModel, conversation: list[Message]) -> MoodState
Functions are pure (no side effects, deterministic output for same input)
